title: SHOP-89 gift-card inclusive boundary
text: A prior gift-card defect rejected valid credit at equality due to >= comparison. Fix changed condition to > with an exact-boundary regression. Similarity supports a hypothesis, not proof.

title: Inventory reservation contention / historical_defects
text: INV-117 resolved in 3.0: a read-modify-write stock decrement caused oversell under contention. Fix used SELECT FOR UPDATE in one transaction; no evidence yet that the same code path is deployed in 3.2.

title: Tenant cache isolation / historical_defects
text: AUTH-209 resolved 5.5: permission cache used subject without tenant prefix. Fix keyed tenantId:subject. Profile cache is a separate implementation and needs independent confirmation.
